entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, serving as an official memory provider for Hermes Agent.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes agent context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system to reduce token consumption. This AGPL-3.0 context database offers observable retrieval trajectories and demonstrated a 91% token reduction in LoCoMo10 benchmarks.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine utilizes a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication to achieve sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It features automated fact extraction and connects directly to external platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: gbrain functions as an opinionated agent brain that provides synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis. It utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges and supports scoped access for multi-user team environments.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to create agent memory that learns over time. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or native Python and Node.js clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library extracts conclusions from conversations through background reasoning processes to build stateful agents. It supports session and peer management via Python and TypeScript SDKs, offering both managed hosting and FastAPI-based self-hosting.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover treats memory as a git repository, providing version control features like branching and merging for a markdown context tree. It utilizes a five-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based to ensure sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database for local storage and sub-millisecond performance. It achieves sub-linear storage growth through episodic compression and supports MCP, Python SDK, and OpenWebUI integrations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context over other data. It runs on local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage vector search, structured facts, and auto-curated wikis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: AutoContext is a recursive self-improving harness that manages context bundles and prompt selection through outcome-gated promotion. It generates traces, playbooks, and training artifacts for local models to help agents succeed on complex tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management by storing messages in a SQLite-backed store with FTS metadata. It builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG, allowing agents to search and expand compacted material without losing original message data.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent by providing a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible provider or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that enables portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy and supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store human-readable data locally for multi-agent systems. It integrates with Hermes-compatible tools like Claude Code and OpenClaw using hybrid retrieval powered by BM25 and local embedders.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, to serve agents via MCP and specialized hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference for Hermes Agent by using block reordering and deduplication to maximize prefix reuse. These techniques reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3× and can save up to 36% of tokens during agentic tasks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory offers a durable, file-based long-term memory solution that avoids vector databases in favor of SQLite with FTS5 search. The ecosystem includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore for structured local storage.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel for Hermes by integrating Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state through SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for every agent query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Developed for the Hermes 2026 Hackathon, this tool uses an anticipatory cache to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It relies on local-first storage via SQLite-vec and provides an MCP-native server for automated configuration.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn establishes cross-project memory for coding agents by using a user's Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores data as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through a combination of semantic search and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace states into verified facts to ensure agents load only the necessary context before a window opens. This local-first architecture can reduce prompt tokens by up to 94% using MCP-native stdio or SSE servers.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 by applying local BM25 ranking to tool schemas. It includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings and supports native tool search optimization.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes an embedded .lbdb graph database to manage agent memory with a built-in 1-10 importance ranking system. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: A Git-backed workflow layer that stores project instructions and state in reviewable Markdown files for coding agents. It features host-neutral lifecycle commands for session management and a migration workflow for importing chat history.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin focuses on data integrity by supporting real, immediate event deletion and providing a trace.jsonl audit log of all operations. It employs an on-demand summarizer to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin uses a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to ensure data persistence. It facilitates pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots through semantic search and state update tools.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle financial transactions using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It allows agents to autonomously pay for API access via the HTTP 402 protocol.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, and runbooks to provide agents with capability routing and artifact search. It supports graph neighbor traversal and uses manual or implicit feedback to optimize how tasks are routed.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and targeted searching. It enhances retrieval accuracy through configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory solution that secures data with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall. It can be deployed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, featuring MinHash deduplication and metadata filtering.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search and grounded Q&A within codebases.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Featuring 17 tools for memory management, this plugin utilizes a hybrid search method combining BM25, vector, and graph traversal. It also implements automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: A file-based curation loop that manages memory hygiene by identifying 'rot' and contradictions in versioned Markdown directories. It uses slash commands to propose evidence-cited diffs, allowing users to review and lint memory without a traditional database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements subagent-driven development to execute engineering tasks autonomously through a structured workflow of brainstorming, planning, and test-driven development. It functions as a plugin for CLI tools and coding agents to enforce rigorous software development methodologies.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system provides a design and prototyping environment compatible with 26 CLI executables, including Hermes Agent. It features a sandboxed iframe for live iterations and exports artifacts into formats such as HTML, PDF, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST AI RMF. The collection is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to enhance agent capabilities in cybersecurity.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee serves as a self-hosted memory platform that builds knowledge graphs to give agents persistent long-term memory across sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers clients in Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables agents to generate 11 different types of diagrams from natural language descriptions. It converts Mermaid text into editable .drawio files and includes built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities for diagram accuracy.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, escrow, and dispute resolution. It utilizes a master router to connect various protocol skills and manage delegated permissions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate 62 distinct categories of detectable AI writing patterns. It is compatible with Hermes and other agents, offering modes for detection, editing in place, or full rewriting.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project enables collective skill evolution and cross-pollination across multiple agents like Hermes and OpenClaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and merging skills to improve agent performance.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library provides 12 metaskills designed to preserve state within a local documentation folder. These spec-conformant plugins are compatible with agentskills.io-compatible agents and Claude Code.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,153 markdown-based skills for professional and life tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent. It includes ready-to-paste exports and integrations for platforms like Slack, Obsidian, and n8n.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set allows agents to perform video searches, extract transcripts, and browse channels or playlists on YouTube. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Windsurf, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects reusable patterns in active workflows to propose and generate new skills. It produces both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom analytical instructions and domain-specific thinking lenses for complex tasks. It enhances transparency by reporting findings alongside a dedicated analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides modular packages for Pydantic AI that support instructions, resources, and scripts through a type-safe framework. It utilizes progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports remote skill registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow skill transforms rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs using Lite or Full modes. It ensures quality through a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into unified .lit.md files. It features a tangler to extract runnable code and automatically syncs source file edits back to the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro provides a harness for long-running agents using a three-level work model and structured memory backed by files or SQLite. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and 'cards' to facilitate cross-feature learning.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Built on the Agent Skills specification, this project allows agents to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, along with specialized services for CRE and ACE.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository serves the Brazilian community by providing Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configurations in Portuguese. All skills follow the agentskills.io standard and are documented in the SKILL.md format.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX image generation models with Python and TypeScript API patterns. The project includes specialized prompting guides for cinematic inserts, product ads, and video generation.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories and developer discourse into version-pinned skills with full audit trails and provenance maps. It links instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits to ensure technical accuracy.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io acts as a registry for reusable AI skills, offering a Python client and CLI for installation with recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features that utilize TON payments for skill access.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex, multi-step tasks through autonomous execution and real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety by providing built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints for task recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project introduces a workflow language for AI that uses a four-verb system to define 'Intent as Code' within a single file. It enhances agent reliability by auditing workflows for costs and permissions before execution and generating hash-chained receipts for verification.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye provides a five-layer retrieval system that uses hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists for the agent. This approach reduces token consumption and features graceful degradation if specific dependencies are missing.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution OS uses a local SQLite database to manage habits and study blocks without cloud synchronization. It connects to AI agents via the Model Context Protocol, allowing the agent to handle system design while the user executes tasks.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard is a read-only code review tool that uses three parallel subagents to hunt for edge cases and exploits. It verifies findings through sandbox execution and incorporates a deterministic pre-scan using tools like Semgrep and Bandit.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across multiple interfaces, including CLI, Discord, and Telegram, while supporting 97 languages. It claims to reduce token usage by 20–80% and scores prompts across five distinct quality dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This adaptation implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates to prevent early-stop errors. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python engine for persistent state management.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI to facilitate tool-based skill loading and automatic directory registration.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. it integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle CVE-driven tasks.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit provides production-tested session management to maintain memory across agent conversations and orchestrates parallel subagents for code reviews. It also includes specialized tools for worktree recovery, state drift detection, and skill scaffolding.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible recording scripts and optimized GIFs for repository documentation. It handles the full pipeline from generation to embedding the final media directly into a README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: Designed to prevent technical debt, this tool generates portable agent skills from plain language while validating them against runtime-specific profiles. It features a monitoring system that tracks official frontmatter specs weekly to detect and report drift.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This project enables terminal-based searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses across multiple protocols including Pay Link and x402. It is built to be compatible with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill works as intended.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable deterministic path routing and environment-specific interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL. They allow agents to verify and use existing project-compatible Python runtimes without new installations.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for managing bounty boards, buying context, and settling payments via x402.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This news briefing generator produces structured reports across multiple geographic scales, from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and applies quality gates to AI-generated analysis.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This suite offers local OCR for PDFs and images alongside video-to-text extraction for platforms like Douyin. It also supports batch generation of e-commerce materials featuring custom brand overlays.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools through a hosted MCP server to provide structured web data across 31 different platforms. It includes five production-grade skills compatible with agents such as Claude, Cursor, and OpenHands.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes, which are automatically updated on a daily basis. It offers a specialized deployment path for users who manage their software environments through the Nix ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and other CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It includes an automated installer for the Antigravity CLI and leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This solution features a one-line automated installer for deploying Hermes Agent within Termux environments on Android. It supports over 70 tools, persistent memory, and integration with both local Ollama models and various cloud API providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart enables the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on cloud-native state safety. It enforces single-writer access for persistent storage and supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows using Custom Resource Definitions.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This project provides a one-command installer to deploy Hermes on both Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It extends the agent's utility with Telegram integration for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This deployment option focuses on hardware-enforced sandboxing using NVIDIA OpenShell to secure the Hermes Agent. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web search and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker-based sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It allows for persistent state through mounted home directories and supports building specific Hermes tags via build arguments.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora serves as a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes environments. It provides management features such as per-agent metrics, cost tracking, and LLM budget caps accessible via REST API, CLI, or MCP.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This repository provides a Nix package and NixOS module for declarative and reproducible Hermes deployments. It features hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration through systemd EnvironmentFiles or sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple Hermes instances from a single web application. It supports RBAC-controlled workspaces, hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, and enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project facilitates headless, production-ready deployments on Ubuntu and Debian servers by configuring Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable deployment package allows Hermes to run from a USB drive or any external storage without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python 3.12 and Git to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework coordinates specialized agents for sentiment, technical, and fundamental analysis to execute financial trades. It features a Portfolio Manager for final transaction approval and supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through Web UI, CLI, and REST interfaces. It supports multi-agent workflows and can be deployed locally via Node.js or through Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages parallel coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, by utilizing git worktrees for task isolation. Users can monitor agents via a TUI or web dashboard with optional sandboxing through Docker and Podman.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling from single VPS agents to automated teams, this template uses a task bus pattern for orchestrator-to-specialist delegation. It includes bundled skills for infrastructure tasks such as VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This project utilizes a level-based architecture to scale Hermes Agent from individual instances to orchestrated specialist teams. It implements a task bus for handoffs and provides built-in skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the creation of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage delegation within agent teams.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface provides a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure roles using a strict pipeline architecture. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of tasks throughout the specialized agent network.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while tracking candidate mutations and frontier progress.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents divided into two competing AI companies. It uses Hermes Agent and Paperclip for task execution, visualizing code and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies. It is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware and utilizes parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that integrates with Hermes Agent via an MCP server. It reduces token usage and tool calls by offering pre-indexed insights for TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust projects.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that tracks token usage and costs for Hermes and other AI coding agents. It features a 3D visualization dashboard and supports data submission to a public leaderboard for performance profiling.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other CLI-based tools. It generates self-contained HTML reports for session analysis and automatically redacts authentication headers to ensure security.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers compatible with Hermes Agent and other markdown-supporting AI providers. It assists developers in building better user interfaces by providing structured architectural constraints.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading the Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers historical session breakdowns to monitor AI tool efficiency.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills to streamline app development with Hermes Agent. It is designed for autonomous execution on both local laptops and remote VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins enables visual customization of the Hermes terminal UI through YAML-based themes. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art to create personalized aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via the Model Context Protocol. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing Hermes workflows and includes an undo function to revert recent agent-driven changes.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol. It allows Hermes agents to register human-readable handles and conduct commerce using USDC and SOL on the Solana network.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This integration suite provides a memory layer for Hermes Agent across platforms like Slack and VS Code using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports various frameworks including CrewAI and LangGraph to enhance agent persistence.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and DevOps, featuring an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining localized skills, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for a full hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with support for 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas at zero cost.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter validates AI agent configurations and tool descriptions using HERM v1.1 scoring to flag overlapping descriptions and inconsistent schemas. It performs deterministic local checks and integrates with GitHub Actions, pre-commit hooks, and SARIF output formats.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and manages the mapping of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability platform monitors multi-agent systems using passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for wake words and barge-in functionality. It operates locally across 35 languages using Piper and Kokoro without requiring API keys or external accounts.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This local-first skill uses dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime to help users generate revenue via Hermes Agent. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for all external actions and utilizing a bounded JSON adapter.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This Tauri 2-based manager provides a cross-platform solution for handling configurations across Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one interface for managing Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full local file access. It integrates multiple external agents, including Hermes Agent, and supports remote interaction through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial experience by providing guided installation and provider setup for Hermes Agent. It includes a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard functions as a local control plane for managing profiles, models, and credentials. It features a visual node-based workflow builder and unified configuration for ten communication channels, including WhatsApp and Slack.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a file browser, Monaco editor, and PTY terminal for direct interaction. It features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, alongside a dedicated memory browser and MCP catalog.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop or self-hosted environment. It supports fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote session management.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and native views for managing Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: This Windows-first desktop application is built with Tauri and includes the Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated UI components for MCP tools and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes. It features Hermes Assist for site-aware drafting and an opt-in controller for executing approved browser tab actions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI application for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from their phone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to manage tasks and skills while providing read-only access to agent memory.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a comprehensive control plane for the Hermes stack, featuring a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It distinguishes itself with an MCP server lifecycle manager and the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS cockpit designed to aggregate searchable transcripts and image previews from 14 different agent sources. It focuses on local privacy and resource management by tracking per-session quota burn for Codex and Claude models without telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace provides a direct interface for managing Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features one-click automated agent installation and integrates a WebRTC voice mode powered by OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It is specifically designed for oversight, featuring an approval inbox for agent requests that trigger side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This project offers a terminal-based alternative for interacting with Hermes Agent using OpenTUI. It combines session management with a kanban board for task tracking and provides tools to manage agent profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA that brings Hermes Agent functionality to the Telegram Mini App platform. It supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows-compatible desktop GUI requires no installation, Docker, or administrative rights to run. It includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers and supports connections to both cloud and local AI models via LM Studio.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and chat capabilities for self-hosted Hermes instances. It includes an integrated file browser and dedicated management panels for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring-focused dashboard allows users to track session activity and costs in real time. It provides read-only access to environment variables and configuration while allowing full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that utilizes tool approval cards and SSE streaming for interactive agent management. It features an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and isolated profile management to keep sessions, memory, and API keys separate.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client facilitates orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports native model switching with streaming responses.
